exposure: Group 1 - slow initial GWG but followed by drastic GWG
Group 3 - maintaining rate of GWG at 0.38 kg/week'
Group 2 - maintaining rate of GWG at 0.58 kg/week
cohort: 2193 pregnant women in Negeri Sembilan, Malaysia
finding: Higher gestational weight gain and increasing gestational weight gain trajectories were associated with a higher risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes.
